notes.title: Version 2.2 Update!
notes.notes:
Another update!

- Bug fixed with sometimes not been able to visit a few locations during the day
- Added Mac English version
- Added 1 bonus (group) scene/event/ending
- Added 4 side characters + story arcs so you can always be pleasantly surprised when venturing into an unintended room
- Added "party" function at night, acting as a gallery for side characters

notes.title: Version 2.1 Update!
notes.notes:
Version 2.1 is here! Thanks for the feedback of early buyers! Below are the major updates:

- Added 2 main story lines/characters, bringing the total to 9!
- Added "help notes" whenever the mouse hovers over an option
- Added "Cheat" function in the morning, it gives you a score for one of the three exams (randomized). Just so those of you who do not want to repeat exams can have an alternative.
- Added an "evening" event where you can choose to access one of three types of galleries
- Added gallery type number one --- change in front of the mirror, for Kenny images
- Added gallery type number two --- fantasize in bathroom, for other character (and sometimes Kenny too) images
- Added gallery type number three --- booty call, to repeat one of the sexual encounters that you have already unlocked (randomized)
- Added new music and text associated with the above changes

For the next update, I will:

- Work on the side encounters
- Work on some group encounters

notes.title: Thanks for your support, new updates coming!
notes.notes:
Hi dear players, I just want to let you know what is coming up next in terms of updates. I'm doing several things: 1) Adding game-play elements that also serve as galleries 2) Adding in new characters, and these will be TOPS because such is very much requested 3) General plot enrichment through "side conversations" 4) Quality of life improvements.

Buy now, keep me funded, and stay tuned!
